The '''Barasin Crag''' was the name given to the spur of rock located at the southern end of the canyon that contained [[Barasin Refuse Yards]]. The crag overlooked a deeper canyon itself, and a bridge connecting the [[Gorinth Plateau]] to the [[Lower Sundari Outpost]] ran directly over the crag.
